text:
Maria (CS): Quick sync: Kaia Labs flagged production onboarding — their Canada + LATAM pilot wants a temporary 2x rate limit for 48h and an IP allowlist for egress. Renewal check-in next Fri; execs worried about persistent latency.

Tilly (Ops): can you paste the customer org id and the IPs?

Maria (CS): org: kaia-labs-prod, ips: 35.197.23.14, 34.89.120.5, 192.0.2.45. They also requested that traffic be routed through ca-central to cut hops.

Raj (Infra): noted. Need approval for temporary quota bump + region routing. Any risk to other tenants? pinging @Sam (SRE).

Sam (SRE): short-term bump OK if it's scoped to the org and a hard time window. I'll add a canary rule and watch P50/P95. Will push config:

```
{
  "org_id": "kaia-labs-prod",
  "rate_limit": "2x",
  "window": "2026-04-06T00:00Z/2026-04-08T00:00Z",
  "allowlist": ["35.197.23.14", "34.89.120.5", "192.0.2.45"],
  "region": "ca-central1"
}
```

Sam (SRE): I'll add alerts for p95>600ms and cost delta >10%.

Jason (AE): I'll tell Kaia execs and add renewal notes. Can Enablement run a 20-min runbook with them?

Tilly (Ops): scheduling runbook Tue 10am PT, invite incoming. tagging @deploy-bot to record the window.

deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance window for kaia-labs-prod: 2026-04-06 00:00Z -> 2026-04-08 00:00Z. Change set cs-1912345678 created.

Maria (CS): thanks — capturing feedback: docs around geo routing need improvement, will loop in docs owner.

Sam (SRE): fallback plan: autocut to model-variant `small-lat` if p95 > 600ms for 3 consecutive mins.

Raj (Infra): PR opened for firewall rule changes: https://git.redwood/infra/firewall/PR-488

Maria (CS): perfect, updating renewal playbook and sending calendar invites.

Jason (AE): thanks team :thumbsup:
